question: Does a single transferable species-by-route-night latent activation state, estimated on opposite routes and layered on the strongest fixed q comparator, reproduce the observed within-taxon concentration and residual spatial dependence?
population: Exactly the 2,835 weather-eligible strictly-prior-history pairs and fixed q matrices used in the 72-h-rainfall comparator.

crossfit.split: Existing deterministic SHA256 route fold A/B.
crossfit.training: Fit the logistic-normal latent state only on dry-route-silent species x route-night clusters from the training fold.
crossfit.test: Each focal route uses mu and sigma estimated only from the opposite route fold.

generator.dry_route_silent_taxa: Draw one u_c per species x route-night cluster and apply it to all ten stop logits.
generator.dry_route_active_taxa: Generate independently from their fixed q probabilities; they do not enter the route-new concentration endpoint.

concentration.statistic: Existing route-new / extra-stop / concentration rainfall coefficients.
concentration.conditioning: Fit concentration_beta ~ route_new_taxon_beta + extra_stop_beta across generator simulations and evaluate the observed concentration residual at observed first-order coefficients.
concentration.sufficient_rule: Observed conditional residual lies within the generator 95% residual interval.

bounded_dependence.sufficient_rule: Observed rho_b=0.28487700425848284 lies within the central 95% generator interval.

far_lag.statistic: Existing pooled stop-number lag 7-9 residual cosine coefficient computed against fixed q.
far_lag.sufficient_rule: Observed far-lag coefficient=0.27178236785618926 lies within the central 95% generator interval.

joint_classification.partial_generator: At least one but not all endpoints pass.

interpretation.pass: A single route-transferable latent species-by-night state is sufficient at the statistical-process level for the tested concentration and dependence summaries.
interpretation.boundary: This is not a unique biological mechanism. The latent state can represent unmeasured hydrology, breeding readiness, demographic availability, social processes or mixtures of them.

anti_tuning: Do not change folds, dry-silent stratum, q matrices, random-effect family, parameter bounds, simulation count, seed, endpoint formulas, conditioning regression or sufficiency rules after readback.
Do not add species-specific sigma, mixtures, distance kernels or additional latent factors after this endpoint is read.
